finding: A requirement-scoped binding mechanism can reduce irrelevant host-profile invalidation while preserving all declared relevant invalidations, but only when the dependency manifest is itself canonical and pinned. The E4 research matrix measured 96 requirement-by-mutation cases: monolithic profile binding invalidated 96/96, scoped binding invalidated 53/96 and preserved 43/96 unrelated cases, with zero false-preserve cases relative to the declared research maps. Manifest narrowing remains a real false-preserve threat unless the expected manifest digest is bound by consumer authority.

preserve: TargetHostProfile whole-profile digest as complete snapshot/provenance identity
profile schema, collector version and generation fences
candidate_additions_after_consumer_depen: Canonical RequirementManifest per real consumer/obligation with exact required field universe
Pinned RequirementManifest digest owned by canonical consumer/build authority
Domain-separated RequirementBindingDigest over the manifest identity plus selected typed fact records
Requirement-local UNKNOWN/freshness debt rather than global unrelated blocking
Explicit HostScopeIdentity and BootScopeIdentity layers so snapshot identity is not overloaded
candidate_reclassification: Volatile session/runtime topology such as pipewire_topology should be treated as HostRuntimeWitness or minimally parsed capability evidence, not long-lived host lineage identity

non_delta: Do not remove or weaken the whole-profile provenance digest.
Do not let runtime/caller packets self-declare or narrow dependency maps.
Do not adopt the four research maps as canonical F2 policy without source-derived consumer dependency evidence.
Do not create E5 BUILD_CANDIDATE from E4 mechanism evidence alone.
Do not grant repository/runtime/physical-host/completion/whole-system credit from this synthetic research ablation.
counterhypothesis: Monolithic invalidation remains the safest fallback whenever the exact consumer dependency universe is unknown or cannot be pinned. Scoped bindings are an optimization only after completeness is executable evidence, not a replacement for conservative failure behavior.

expected_benefit.measured: 43/96 consumer-binding invalidations avoided in the declared synthetic matrix (44.7916666667%)
expected_benefit.expected: less unnecessary host revalidation and narrower evidence invalidation while preserving complete snapshot provenance

acceptance_falsifier: Enumerate each actual WP1201 consumer from current source; derive and pin its exact RequirementManifest; mutate every required field and OBSERVED/UNKNOWN transition and require invalidation/block; mutate every non-required field and require preservation; narrow/tamper the manifest and require rejection. Any false-preserve, unbound manifest or unknown dependency keeps monolithic fallback authoritative.
handoff: Triggerword 4/source-integration lane should perform the real-consumer dependency audit under existing mutation authority and only then decide whether a successor component implementation is warranted.
